name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: Two round avatars side by side: one that preloads a remote image and shows delayed initials fallback while it loads, and one that is fallback-only initials.
stateManaged: none — purely declarative; the image loading status and delayed fallback are handled internally by the component
nonTrivialInteractions: Avatar.Image preloads the remote src and only renders the once loaded, so the fallback is what is visible until then
Avatar.Fallback delay={600} suppresses the initials for 600ms to avoid a fallback flash when the image loads quickly
Second Avatar.Root has no Avatar.Image child, so the initials fallback renders unconditionally
